# Hugging Face Transformers Skill

Agent skill for using Hugging Face Transformers models from Claude/OpenClaw.

## Repository
https://github.com/kaigritun/huggingface-transformers-skill

## Description
Provides easy access to 150k+ pre-trained models for text generation, sentiment analysis, NER, translation, image classification, and more via simple Python scripts with JSON output.

## Features
- Text generation with GPT-2, GPT-Neo, Mistral, etc.
- Sentiment analysis with DistilBERT
- Named entity recognition
- Translation models
- JSON output for easy agent integration
- Works with any model on Hugging Face Hub

## Created in response to
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/42971

Ready for review and addition to the skills registry.
